description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureBasedReminderTable class, which manages reminder entries stored in Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for starting, stopping, reading, upserting, and deleting reminder entries, along with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: AzureBasedReminderTable
classes.description: A class implementing IReminderTable that manages reminder entries in Azure Table Storage, providing methods for lifecycle management and CRUD operations with detailed logging.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, retrying on failure until success or cancellation.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the reminder table operations and cancels ongoing initialization if any.

methods.name: ConvertFromTableEntryList
methods.description: Converts a list of table entries into ReminderTableData.

methods.name: ConvertFromTableEntry
methods.description: Converts a single ReminderTableEntry into a ReminderEntry object, verifying service ID.

methods.name: ConvertToTableEntry
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntry into a ReminderTableEntry suitable for storage.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in the table.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry based on grain ID, reminder name, and ETag.
